content: Recently, Peters et al. BIBREF19 proposed ELMo word representations. ELMo extends a traditional word embedding model with features produced bidirectionally with character convolutions. It has been shown that the utilization of ELMo for different NLP tasks result in improved performance compared to other types of word embedding models such as Word2Vec BIBREF20 , GloVe BIBREF21 , and fastText BIBREF22 .
